title: Launch-fragmented pointwise chain: affine -> SiLU -> residual -> clamp -> affine
authoring_note: KernelBench-style pointwise chain at torch level (no triton). Baseline runs the chain as 8 separate eager ops; the reference fix fuses via torch.jit.script, which is safe on both CPU-only CI and CUDA hosts. Calibrate expected_speedup_range to the authoring host.
